styleLock.direction: premium minimalist hardware ecommerce, dark editorial opening plus clean paper-white infographic screens

palette.name: 石板蓝灰门板与标签条

styleLock.backgroundSystem: only two fields: a low-key charcoal studio built from stacked matte fine-grain stone plinths, and a paper-white infographic field carrying one slate-painted flush door panel; no other environment anywhere in the set
styleLock.lightingSystem: metal is always lit by a hard raking side key from camera left that pulls one long specular band along the plating, with a wide soft bounce on the shadow side; dark screens fall off into #1A1A1C, infographic screens run even and near-shadowless; 5000-5600K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte fine-grain stone blocks, cast-plaster wall, painted flush door panel, matte paper-white card fields; every object stands on a real contact shadow
styleLock.typography: one high-contrast serif display face for headlines plus one light geometric sans-serif for body, labels and numbers; two faces only, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, rendered copy always in short Chinese callouts wrapped in 「」
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline single-weight outline icons and rounded pill labels hung on 1px leader lines, drawn in #2A2A2C on light fields and #F7F5F1 on dark fields, accents in {accent_color}
styleLock.presentationRules: the handle keeps one proportional scale across all screens; the rose stays circular and the spindle axis stays level unless an angle demands otherwise; light rakes from camera left in every shot; plating must read as true anodized metal, never as plastic; no brand mark, wordmark, QR code, coupon, price or review copy may appear
noDrift: no mixed fonts beyond the one serif display plus one geometric sans
no inconsistent lighting direction or shadow strength
no mismatched icon or label styles
no invented measurement numbers, certifications, awards or lab data
no plastic sheen on metal and no product floating without a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium minimalist hardware-ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of low-key charcoal #1A1A1C, paper-warm off-white #F7F5F1, slate blue-grey #5B6A80 for the door panel and label bars, and one accent colour injected as {accent_color}; cool neutral grade; one high-contrast serif display face for headlines plus one light geometric sans-serif for body, labels and numbers, never a third face; backgrounds limited to a stacked matte-stone plinth studio and a clean paper-white infographic field; lighting always a hard raking side key from camera left that pulls one long specular band along the plated metal, with a wide soft bounce on the shadow side and a 5000-5600K colour temperature; hairline outline icons and rounded pill labels on 1px leader lines; stable product scale and centring across every screen, metal rendered with true anodized reflectance and never a plastic sheen; every piece grounded by a visible contact shadow; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no coupons, no invented specs.

provenance.notes: 9 张详情页切片拆解为 10 镜（合并重复编号细节卡、补 1 张白底主图与 1 张痛点镜）。已剥离：源图英文标语与衬线标题原文、中文促销角标与二维码、'加入会员 全店免费'类店铺权益文案、店铺/品牌字样、模特与联系方式，全部改为 {selling_point_*}/{callout_*} 占位符。孔距与外形尺寸（源图标注的毫米数）、材质名称、适配门厚等数值一律脱敏为占位符，不写死。未生成任何认证、质检报告、奖项、评分或销量数据。品类判定：主体为室内门分体式把手锁（机械五金，非智能门锁），故 L1 取内置清单中的 家装灯具、L2 取 五金（而非 手机数码/智能家居，也不取 家具家纺/建材）；源批处理夹标注为『家装家具家用品』，与清单 L1 名『家装灯具』字面不一致，属清单收纳口径差异，门门窗五金按清单归 家装灯具>五金。五金镜统一采用掠射侧光表现镀层与金属反射，并保留门体安装场景镜。
